title: Approximation by a Hamming tail
statement: For natural numbers $q$ and $r$, the approximation property holds when both of the following inequalities hold on the uniformly distributed sign cube of dimension $r+1$: the expected value of the Hamming upper-tail indicator at the threshold for $q$ differs from $1/(q+2)$ by less than half that mass, and its level-one Fourier weight differs from the square of the Gaussian boundary value for $q$ by less than half that square.
